caption: The drawing depicts a single oval-shaped plate rendered in shades of gray, giving it a metallic or ceramic appearance. The plate is centrally placed within a large, lightly sketched square frame. Below the main image, there is a smaller box containing a simplified outline sketch of the plate viewed from above and from the side, showing its proportions and profile. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color. In the lower left corner, the text "INTERNATIONAL CO.-CHINA- TREATON" is written, and in the lower right corner, there is an artist's signature. The overall composition is sparse, focusing attention on the plate and its two schematic views.
title: Server Dish
